messages.author: Malinok
messages.text: There needs to be a better balance on equipment.  Right now many smaller nations have no access to planes or navy.  This situation did not stop Vietnam or Afghanistan  from defending themselves and defeating America or Russia. It will also cause many new people to leave when they are raiding by forces they have no hope of dealing with.

messages.author: slotherer
messages.text:
I agree in principle, but perhaps a relook at war mechanics as a whole?

If something closer to realism (imo) then winning or losing is all on ground troops. Just like Vietnam. Air and Ships soften  ground troops and provide cover/intel to prepare for ground attacks. I mean someone hit me with planes and looted money... Those some beam me up tech right there.
